narrative.summary: Each treasury is one HyperCore key holding over 99.9% of the token's max supply. HIP-1 has no mint after genesis, so this balance is the effective mint authority. Unit's 2-of-3 MPC claim cannot be verified on chain.
narrative.tag: on-chain single key vs documented 2-of-3 MPC
narrative.detail: The treasuries hold 99.9669%, 99.9411% and 99.9286% of max supply for UBTC, UETH and USOL, and each reads as a plain single key. Tokens it sends are indistinguishable from backed ones on HyperCore, and they serve as collateral elsewhere: HyperLend lists all three. Unit's docs say the key is a 2-of-3 threshold signature held by Unit, Hyperliquid and Infinite Field; that is recorded as context, not scored, because the chain cannot confirm it. The three share one token deployer (a native 2-of-3 multisig at a different address), a real correlation not counted in cross-exposure.

independent_read.why: no code at this address on the chain's mainnet: a derived identifier for a native (non-EVM) entity such as HyperCore, or a contract that lives on another chain (a rollup's own L1 contracts); nothing for this reader to compare here
